name: io.github.AM-Digital-Research-Environment/amira-mcp-server
title: AMIRA — Africa Multiple Research Data
description: Read-only access to AMIRA, the Africa Multiple research-data platform on Omeka S.

tools.name: get_collection_overview
tools.description: Start here: corpus counts, text coverage, breakdowns, dates, snapshot freshness and refresh status.

tools.name: search_research_items
tools.description: Search digitised research items. Filters are AND-combined; empty results suggest a filter to relax or a stored place name. export links all matches as a file.

keyword.description: Every word must occur in the title, description, abstract, contents or identifiers; quote a phrase to match it exactly

subject.description: Subject heading, partial (e.g. 'Architecture'). Subjects absorb the former free-form tags — there is no tag filter

location.description: A place at ANY level of the city→country hierarchy: 'Nigeria' finds Lagos items, 'Lagos' finds only Lagos

location_id.description: Exact location authority ID, including descendants; avoids homonym matches

country.description: Country only, exact name or common alias ('Côte d'Ivoire' = 'Ivory Coast'). Use `location` for cities

contributor.description: A person/organisation credited on the item; either name order works

university.description: ubt | unilag | ujkz | ufba | external — code or full name

genre.description: Format term or physical note, partial (e.g. 'interview', 'photograph')

collection.description: Collection id, code or partial title from list_collections

language.description: Name or ISO code — 'French', 'fr', 'fra' and legacy 'fre' all match

mentions_country.description: ILAM African Music articles whose full text names this country 3+ times

year_from.description: Keep items whose content dates overlap from this year

year_to.description: Keep items whose content dates overlap up to this year

has_media.description: true: only items with digitised files

added_since.description: Added to AMIRA on or after this ISO date

modified_since.description: Changed on or after this ISO date

export.description: Return a file link instead of rows

tools.name: get_research_item
tools.description: Research-item metadata, linked entities, rights, media files, IIIF manifest and a generated citation (BibTeX/RIS/CSL-JSON). Long fields cap at 25,000 characters.

id.description: Omeka id (the number ending its amira_url, e.g. 9902) or a typed id such as research_item:9902

citation_format.description: Export format for the generated citation: bibtex (default) → `bibtex`, ris → `ris`, csl-json → `csl_json`

include_similar.description: Add up to 5 similar records, each explained

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search project names, descriptions and membership. Returns cited summaries and item counts; use get_project for detail.

keyword.description: Every word must occur in the name, an acronym or the description; quote a phrase

university.description: ubt | unilag | ujkz | ufba | external — code or name. A data facet, not a full AMRC list

principal_investigator.description: A PI name; either order works ('Erdmute Alber' finds 'Alber, Erdmute')

member.description: A project member's name; either order works

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Project description, team, sections, funders, item counts by type, top subjects and ten sample research items, with citation links.

id.description: Project Omeka id (e.g. 37700) or typed id project:37700

include_similar.description: Add up to 5 similar records, each explained

tools.name: list_research_sections
tools.description: Cluster research sections, funding phases, project/item counts and citation links. Includes the external-collection grouping.

tools.name: get_research_section
tools.description: One research section's description, team and projects, each with its research-item count.

name.description: Section name, e.g. 'Arts & Aesthetics' ('and' for '&' works)

id.description: Section Omeka id or typed id section:<id> from list_research_sections; not with name

tools.name: search_persons
tools.description: Find canonical person authority records. Names accept either order and ignore accents. Use resolve_entity to disambiguate homonyms.

keyword.description: Matches the name, a name variant or an affiliation

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Person affiliations, identifiers, project and section roles, credited items, publications, podcasts, videos, Cluster Chronicles works and collaborators. Lists cap at 50 with totals. Use id to disambiguate.

name.description: Full name in either order, with or without accents: 'Beier, Ulli' and 'Ulli Beier' both resolve

id.description: Exact person Omeka id or typed id (person:123); required to disambiguate homonyms

tools.name: list_institutions
tools.description: Browse institution authorities (and untyped organisations, marked kind) by name or acronym (e.g. 'UJKZ'), with project counts and citation links.

keyword.description: Name or acronym, partial; several words must all match

tools.name: get_institution
tools.description: Institution or group profile: identifiers, members, funded projects and credited items, with citation links.

name.description: Institution or group name, or an acronym

id.description: Omeka id or typed id organisation:1224

tools.name: list_cluster_partners
tools.description: Cluster partner institutions grouped by catalogue category, with citation links.

category.description: Optional: amrc | privileged | cooperation | global, or a category label

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: Browse group authorities by name, mostly performing ensembles credited on research items, with item counts and citation links.

keyword.description: Name or acronym, partial; several words must all match

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: Subject headings (LCSH or free tags) ranked by distinct research-item count. Feed a heading into search_research_items.subject.

keyword.description: Filter on the heading; every word must match, quote a phrase

vocabulary.description: lcsh, tag, or unspecified: every other heading (mostly places with no vocabulary)

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: Research places with coordinates and ancestor rollups. Two tiers: level "country" or "place" (city, region or site); one item counts under both. Feed a name into search_research_items.location.

filters.description: Research-item filters applied before place counts

country.description: One country, exact name or alias, plus its cities

keyword.description: Filter on the place name; every word must match, quote a phrase

near.description: Places within km (> 0) of a point; latitude -90..90, longitude -180..180

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north]; west > east crosses the antimeridian

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Research collections, one per project, ranked by research-item count and cited by the project page. Feed an id or code into search_research_items.collection.

keyword.description: Filter on the collection title, project name or code; every word must match

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Ranked formats, languages or resource types used by research items. Feed values into the corresponding search filters.

category.description: 'genres' = 'formats' (controlled terms); 'physical_notes' lists free-text notes. Both feed genre. Tags: use list_subjects

keyword.description: Filter on the value; every word must match, quote a phrase

tools.name: list_years
tools.description: Research-item year/decade histogram with dated and undated counts. A date range counts in each spanned bucket. dated_items and year_range follow from/to. Supports item filters and paging.

sort.description: Default 'chronological' (oldest first); 'count' ranks by item count

tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: AND-filtered bibliography, newest first. Keyword includes PDF text and returns match snippets. citation_format returns citations per page; export links every match as one file. Cite amira_url.

keyword.description: Title, abstracts, venue, subjects or full text; every word must match, quote a phrase

type.description: Exact type; discover values with list_publication_facets

added_since.description: Added to AMIRA on or after this ISO date

citation_format.description: Omit for summaries; pages carry bibtex, ris or csl_json

include_abstract.description: Add abstract (first 1,200 chars) and subjects to each summary

export.description: Return a file link instead of rows

limit.description: Default 25; max 100 summaries or 25 citation_format rows, also byte-bounded. export ignores it

tools.name: get_publication
tools.description: Publication metadata and citation export (BibTeX default). Full text is opt-in and paginated. Cite amira_url; DOI/repository links are additional sources.

id.description: Publication Omeka id or typed id publication:29919

citation_format.description: Default bibtex; selects bibtex, ris or csl_json field

include_fulltext.description: Default false — set true to include the extracted full text

fulltext_offset.description: Start offset into the full text (chars), with include_fulltext

include_similar.description: Add up to 5 similar records, each explained

tools.name: list_publication_facets
tools.description: Ranked facets for the entire filtered bibliography before pagination. Uses the same selection rules as search_publications.

keyword.description: Title, abstracts, venue, subjects or full text; every word must match, quote a phrase

type.description: Exact type; discover values with list_publication_facets

added_since.description: Added to AMIRA on or after this ISO date

tools.name: list_journals
tools.description: Publication venues ranked by linked bibliography records, with ISSN and catalogue links.

keyword.description: Filter on the journal title; every word must match, quote a phrase

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Subjects, people, places and projects connected through shared records. Per-corpus counts deduplicate each record; subject/person seeds also include publications, subject/place/person seeds Cluster Chronicles works. Returns ambiguity and cited samples.

entity_type.description: What the value denotes. Tags are merged into subjects. research_item: the id of an ILAM African Music article, related by full text. record: any embedded record, related by meaning

value.description: The entity to pivot on. subject: substring of a heading ('Islam'). location: any level of the city→country hierarchy ('Nigeria' includes Lagos items). person: a name in either order, accent-insensitive ('Beier, Ulli'). project: an Omeka id ('37700'), a legacy key, or the project name or whole words of it. research_item: an item id ('27733' or 'research_item:27733'), not a text query. record: an omeka_id or typed id ('publication:29919')

limit.description: Cap on each related_* list, default 20, max 50; sample lists show at most 10

tools.name: search_podcasts
tools.description: Search podcast metadata and transcripts. Text-only hits include snippets; full transcripts require get_podcast with opt-in.

keyword.description: Every word must occur in the title, abstract or transcript; quote a phrase to match it exactly

person.description: A speaker/host name; either name order works

language.description: Name or ISO code — 'French', 'fr', 'fra' all match

tools.name: get_podcast
tools.description: Podcast detail, duration, audio file and citation link; says which model generated the transcript. Transcript is opt-in, bounded and pageable.

id.description: Podcast id from search_podcasts, e.g. 39121, or podcast:39121

include_transcript.description: Default false — set true to include the transcript text

transcript_offset.description: Start offset into the transcript (chars), with include_transcript

include_similar.description: Add up to 5 similar records, each explained

tools.name: search_videos
tools.description: Search video metadata and transcripts. Text-only hits include snippets; full transcripts require get_video with opt-in.

keyword.description: Every word must occur in the title, abstract or transcript; quote a phrase to match it exactly

speaker.description: A speaker name; either name order works

language.description: Name or ISO code — 'French', 'fr', 'fra' all match

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Video detail, thumbnail and citation link; says how the transcript was produced when recorded. Transcript is opt-in, bounded and pageable.

id.description: Video id from search_videos, e.g. 39218, or video:39218

include_transcript.description: Default false — set true to include the transcript text

transcript_offset.description: Start offset into the transcript (chars), with include_transcript

include_similar.description: Add up to 5 similar records, each explained

tools.name: search_chronicles
tools.description: Search Cluster Chronicles works (writer-in-residence essays, poems, photos, events) by chronicler, form, year, subject, place or keyword. Text-only hits include snippets.

keyword.description: Every word must occur in the title, abstract or text; quote a phrase to match it exactly

person.description: A chronicler, other credited person or person depicted; either name order works

form.description: Form: essay, poem, still image, event, video

place.description: Place at any level ('Kenya' includes Kakamega) or a venue, partial

tools.name: get_chronicle
tools.description: One Cluster Chronicles work: chroniclers and roles, people depicted, subjects, places, related works and recordings, images, links. Abstracts are AI-written (says which model). Text opt-in and pageable.

id.description: Id from search_chronicles, e.g. 50109, or chronicle:50109

include_text.description: Default false — set true to include the full text of an essay or poem

text_offset.description: Start offset into the text (chars), with include_text

tools.name: resolve_entity
tools.description: Resolve a label or typed ID to cited candidates. Returns ambiguity instead of merging names. Use a returned id with get_entity_graph or get_* tools.

tools.name: get_entity_graph
tools.description: One-hop graph from a typed ID: explicit catalogue links and derived co-occurrence with distinct-record counts and cited evidence. types filters neighbours before the bounds. Pass edge_id to page its evidence; pin snapshot_id across pages.

tools.name: get_text_passages
tools.description: Find accent-insensitive passages of one literal phrase (quotes optional; words are not matched separately) in selected publication/video/podcast/chronicle IDs. Original UTF-16 offsets, bounded context, citations. Requires full text exposure.

ids.description: publication:, video:, podcast: or chronicle: ids

tools.name: compare_collections
tools.description: Compare 2–4 projects or collections (id or code from list_collections) with identical research-item filters. Reports denominators, missingness, dates and top types/languages.

tools.name: get_data_quality
tools.description: Snapshot coverage and missing metadata, unresolved loaded-authority links, semantic-neighbour coverage and sanitized refresh status. Missing catalogue metadata is not evidence of real-world absence.

tools.name: get_snapshot_changes
tools.description: Page added/updated/deleted records between retained snapshots from this Omeka instance. Lists available snapshot IDs when fewer than two exist. For recent additions without history, use added_since on the search tools.

tools.name: get_fulltext_map
tools.description: ILAM's journal African Music by its private full text, from public derived counts: AI-labelled content groups, countries named, word rates per year. Never returns text.

words.description: Single words: yearly rates per 10,000 words instead of the overview

tools.name: get_similar_items
tools.description: Records whose catalogue descriptions read most alike (EmbeddingGemma 2 vectors), across research items, publications, videos, podcasts, projects and sections. Each says what else it shares (subjects, places, people, project) or wording_only.

id.description: omeka_id, or a typed id such as publication:29919

tools.name: get_semantic_map
tools.description: The collection as unnamed groups of records close in meaning (k-means over EmbeddingGemma 2 vectors): size, type mix, top subjects, countries and projects, records nearest the centre. `group` lists one; `id` finds a record's group.

group.description: A group id: list its records, nearest the centre first

id.description: A record (omeka_id or typed id): its group

types.description: With group/id: only these record types

tools.name: search
tools.description: Ranked search across items, publications, videos, podcasts, projects and sections. Returns typed IDs, titles and citation URLs. Fetch selected records for evidence.

query.description: A few keywords, names, places or themes — e.g. 'Yoruba architecture'. Terms are matched individually, so concise queries beat full sentences

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read a typed search result as a cited document. Full text/transcripts are opt-in and pageable; metadata and text respect exposure policy. Unknown ID returns an error.

id.description: A typed record id from search (item:9902, pub:30001, video:…, podcast:…, project:…, section:…) or resolve_entity

include_transcript.description: Default false — set true to append the video/podcast transcript

transcript_offset.description: Start offset into the transcript (chars), with include_transcript

include_fulltext.description: Default false — set true to append a publication's extracted full text

fulltext_offset.description: Start offset into the full text (chars), with include_fulltext

max_chars.description: Cap on the whole returned text body, default/max 25000
